name: Sonoma Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Sonoma Cabernet tends toward anise and black olive notes.

blurb.text: A southeastern Sonoma County AVA, in the valley known as the Valley of the Moon. It contains the Moon Mountain District.
